title: CQRS Command/Query Data Flow Pattern
summary: 读写责任分离数据流模式：写命令 (Command) 与读查询 (Query) 完全解耦，防止领域写逻辑与多维读查询逻辑污染。
data_flow_diagram:
Client -> Command -> CommandHandler -> DomainEntity -> Repository (Write)
Client -> Query -> QueryHandler -> DTO -> View (Read)

data_schema.CreateOrderCommand: { order_id: string, item_ids: string[], user_id: string }
data_schema.OrderReadDTO: { order_id: string, status: string, total_price: number }

example_cases.title: Command Handler Pattern
example_cases.code_snippet:
class CreateOrderCommandHandler:
    async def handle(self, cmd: CreateOrderCommand) -> str:
        order = Order.create(cmd.user_id, cmd.item_ids)
        await self.repo.save(order)
        return order.id

agent_instructions: 1. 确认请求是写操作 (Command) 还是读操作 (Query)。
2. 禁止在 CommandHandler 中直接拼接复杂的读视图 SQL；禁止在 QueryHandler 中触发状态修改。
